chemistry-killer-10.material:
Mai zuwa shi ne ma'aunin haɗa ammonia. $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (amsawar fitar zafi). A cikin kwantena mai rufi a zafi tsayayye wanda ya kai equilibrium, an canza yanayi kowanne daban kuma an kai sabon equilibrium.
(I) A rage girman kwantena yayin da zafi ke tsayayye.
(II) A ƙara zafi yayin da girma ke tsayayye.
(III) A ƙara Ar(g) wanda ba ya amsawa yayin da zafi da girma ke tsayayye.
(IV) A ƙara Ar(g) yayin da zafi da (jimillar) matsin lamba ke tsayayye kuma girma ya ƙaru.
(V) A ƙara $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$ yayin da zafi da girma ke tsayayye.
Waɗanne yanayi ne kaɗai ke sa mole (mol) na $\mathrm{NH_3}$ a sabon equilibrium ya fi na equilibrium na asali?

(V) Ƙara $\mathrm{H_2}$ → Q < K → amsawar gaba → ɓangare na H2 ya ƙare kuma NH3 yana ƙaruwa (mole na NH3 yana ƙaruwa).
